name: ira
description: an Ira, a crouching red demon spawned by the Avatar of Wrath: red skin with black tiger stripes, a wild spiky black mane sweeping back, a glaring white eye, pointed ears and a snarling fanged mouth, spiked black bracers, a dark belt with a round steel buckle over a ragged black loincloth, dark wraps on the shins, a curved jagged dark-steel blade raised high in his LEFT hand on the screen-right side, and a second curved jagged blade held low in his RIGHT hand on the screen-left side
hands: the raised jagged blade stays in his left hand on the screen-right side, and his right hand on the screen-left side keeps holding the second jagged blade low

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back, the curved jagged blade in his left hand is lifted up over the head with its point up and back, the second jagged blade still held low in his right hand
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and slightly crouched, the jagged blade cocked behind the head with its point hanging down behind the shoulders, the right arm with the second jagged blade tucked in low
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips forward, the left arm sweeps over the head and the curved jagged blade is level, pointing to the lower-right, the second blade still low in his right hand
strike.4: contact: left arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the curved jagged blade slashing down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the right arm with the second jagged blade swung back for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the curved jagged blade carries on down until its point nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the spiky black mane trailing back, the second blade held back in his right hand
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the jagged blade lifts back toward its raised ready angle, the second blade returning low in front

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the right arm with the low second blade flung out to the left, the raised blade arm thrown up and out), the black mane whipping
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the raised jagged blade tilting out to the right, the second blade still held out to the left

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, the blade arm flung up, the right arm with the second jagged blade drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head and black mane droop, both jagged blades lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the point of the jagged blade resting on the ground, the right arm hanging with the second blade
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, both jagged blades slip out of his hands, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the spiky black mane spread on the ground; one jagged blade lies on the ground at the lower-right and the second beside him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the black mane settles
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, fangs bared, both jagged blades on the ground beside him
